Body.Content:
Microsoft Purview extends data security controls to the network layer through integration with Azure Firewall, helping organizations detect and protect sensitive data in supported network traffic, including text, files, and AI interactions. Organizations are able to enforce DLP policies on traffic from servers, virtual machines, and other endpoints, including traffic generated by background services and automated workloads. These controls help prevent unauthorized sharing with cloud applications through browsers, applications, and APIs. The integration will also provide activity signals to Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management to help identify risky user behavior, with alert management and investigation supported across Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Defender.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
